openClinicalQuestions: Confirm the age threshold WHD quotes for Indian patients, since NHS uses under 36 versus 36 and over.

claimLedger.claim: See a doctor after a year of trying if under 36, and sooner with age or known problems. Smoking, alcohol and weight are discussed.
claimLedger.limitations: UK pathways and age cut-offs; Indian referral rules differ.

claimLedger.claim: Have vaginal sex every two to three days. Most couples conceive within a year.
